description: Get one sweep by `id`: name, description, testConfigId and profileIds. Use when: you have a sweep id (from listSweeps or a sweep run's sweepId). Read-only. Needs testing:read. Returns 404 if the sweep is not in your workspace.
name: getSweep

outputSchema.description:
A sweep runs a single `TestConfig` across multiple profiles (personas). Useful for
regression-testing the same call flow with different caller personas.

profileIds.description: Profile IDs to sweep through (one run per profile).

testConfigId.description: The single TestConfig to run against each profile.

title: Get Test Sweep
